decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'P1 — Save a bookmark: paste a web address; the app records it'. R1 client: 'I approve the specification and the five assumptions.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Save-by-url presented and conforms to REF-BM-01.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'auto-fills the page title when it can'; R2 maker: 'Best-effort title fetch'. R1 client bare approval. Reference REF-BM-02 requires title, description, favicon AND preview image.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented metadata collection reduced to title only vs spec's title/description/favicon/preview; divergence established. Client approved without expressing the difference.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Browse & open: ... click through to the original page'; R4 maker: 'opens in a new tab'. Client approvals.
decisions.note: Navigate-to-original presented and conforms to REF-BM-08.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'see everything you've saved'; R4 maker: 'newest-first list, ... empty state'.
decisions.note: Readability-first list presented; no contradiction of item exposure establishable, treated as conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Edit & delete: fix a title/address'; R4 maker: 'US3 Edit & delete — edit form'.
decisions.note: Edit presented; reduced field mention ('title/address') insufficient to firmly establish exclusion of tags/notes/description editing, so not counted as divergence.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'remove a bookmark (with a confirm step)'; R4 maker: 'delete with a required confirmation'.

R1 maker: 'duplicate warning'; R2 maker: 'warns (doesn't silently duplicate) when you re-save the same address'; R4 maker: 'warns on duplicates (with "save anyway")'. Client bare approvals. Reference REF-BM-06 requires guiding the user to edit the existing bookmark, converging/preventing duplicates.
decisions.note: Presented duplicate handling (warn but allow 'save anyway') diverges from spec's converge-to-edit-existing/prevent-duplicate rule. Divergence established; passed on bare approval.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Tags are included (used for filtering)'; R4 maker tags in bookmarks. Client approvals.
decisions.note: Assigning tags presented and conforms to REF-BM-09.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'filter by tag'; R4 maker: 'tag filter'. Client approvals.
decisions.note: Tag filtering presented and conforms to REF-BM-11.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'search by term'; R4 maker: 'live search over title/address/notes/tags'.
decisions.note: Basic full-text search presented; conforms to REF-BM-12. (Advanced search operators/phrase/#-syntax REF-BM-13..16 were never presented and are coverage gaps, not classifiable presented decisions.)

decisions.evidence: R1 maker assumption 5: 'notes are a free-text field per bookmark'. R1 client: 'I approve ... the five assumptions.' Reference REF-BM-23 requires a markdown note rendered when viewing.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presenting notes as plain free-text diverges from spec's markdown note with rendering; divergence established. Approved without expressing the difference.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker assumption 4: 'No import/export from browsers or files in v1.' R1 client: 'I approve ... the five assumptions.' Reference includes REF-BM-30 (import Netscape HTML) and REF-BM-31 (export Netscape HTML).
decisions.note: Spec gate. Import/export explicitly scoped out — a presented decision diverging from two reference items; treated as one decision. Client approved without expressing the expectation.
